# Vendored SARIF schema

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 JSON Schema
incorporating Approved Errata 01, downloaded from:

<https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json>

SHA-256: `c3b4bb2d6093897483348925aaa73af03b3e3f4bd4ca38cef26dcb4212a2682e`

It is vendored only for offline conformance tests. SARIF 2.1.0 is an OASIS
Standard; see the copyright and licensing notices in the standard and schema.
